title: Product seller must pass on warnings or instructions
description: Product seller must pass on warnings or instructions of the product manufacturer regarding the dangers involved or proper usage of the product

content.what: must pass on warnings or instructions of the product manufacturer
conditions: he did not pass on the warnings or instructions of the product manufacturer regarding the dangers involved or proper usage of the product while selling such product
such failure was the proximate cause of the harm
limitations: he has exercised substantial control over the designing, testing, manufacturing, packaging or labelling of a product that caused harm
he has altered or modified the product and such alteration or modification was the substantial factor in causing the harm

he has made an express warranty of a product independent of any express warranty made by a manufacturer and such product failed to conform to the express warranty made by the product seller which caused the harm
